description.zh:
查询条件名称。取值范围：

- ResellerUid：分销商uid。

- Name：分销商名称
description.en:
The name of the filter condition. Valid values:

- ResellerUid: The UID of the reseller.

- Name: The name of the reseller.
The values of the filter condition.

description.zh: 分页查询时每页行数。最大值为100。
description.en: The number of entries to return on each page. Maximum value: 100.
The token that is used to retrieve the next page of results.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun computenestsupplier list-resellers --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --max-results 20 --next-token AAAAAWVmrOoWHbw/80lX0TWxe/s= --filter '[{"Value":["分销商A"],"Name":"Name"}]' --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun computenestsupplier ListResellers --region cn-hangzhou --NextToken 'AAAAAWVmrOoWHbw/80lX0TWxe/s=' --Filter.1.Value.1 '分销商A' --MaxResults 20 --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --Filter.1.Name Name
